character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A cute rice-field crab monster for a game, small round dark brown shell
with a lighter tan belly, two pincers with one slightly bigger than the
other raised in a playful threatening pose, big round eyes on short
stalks, a few mud splashes and a tiny green rice sprout stuck on top of
its shell, six short legs, cute chibi monster, big expressive eyes with
bright highlights, smooth soft shading, colored darker outlines instead
of pure black, vivid saturated colors
